reply: According to the text, treason against the United States consists only in levying war against them or adhering to their enemies and giving them aid and comfort. No person can be convicted of treason unless on the testimony of two witnesses to the same overt act or by confession in open court. Additionally, Congress has the power to declare the punishment for treason, but no attainder of treason shall work corruption of blood or forfeiture except during the lifetime of the person attainted [1][4].
